title: CrowdStrike Holdings (CRWD) Gains as Autonomous AI Agents Go Mainstream

Soumya Eswaran

Thu, August 13, 2026 at 9:41 AM EDT 3 min read

TCW Funds, an investment management firm, published its second-quarter 2026 investor letter for the 'TCW Concentrated Large Cap Growth Fund.' A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. During the second quarter, AI monetization, a fragile Middle East ceasefire, and a Federal Reserve leadership transition were the significant events. All major indices ended higher, driven by resilient economic growth and strong corporate earnings. April marked a recovery from March lows, with the S&P 500 achieving record highs by early June, largely due to robust corporate earnings linked to AI capital spending. Although the fund appreciated 14.45% in the quarter, it trailed the Russell 1000® Growth Index's 16.74% and the S&P 500's 15.20% returns. Holdings in healthcare and financials hurt relative results most, while information technology and consumer discretionary holdings positively impacted relative performance during the quarter.  Please review the Fund's top five holdings to gain insights into their key selections for 2026.

In its Q2 2026 investor letter, TCW Concentrated Large Cap Growth Fund highlighted CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD). Headquartered in Austin, Texas, CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD) is a leading cybersecurity technology company. On August 12, 2026, CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD) closed at $221.78 per share, reflecting a market capitalization of $225.83 billion. CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD) posted a one‑month return of 10.07%, while its shares gained 111.168% over the past 52 weeks."

TCW Concentrated Large Cap Growth Fund stated the following regarding CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"Shares of CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:CRWD) also positively contributed to relative performance after posting solid quarterly results which included NNARR (Net New Annual Recurring Revenue) of $256M (+32% YoY), non-GAAP operating margin of 24% (+6% YoY), and FCF of $469M (+67% YoY). Management also raised forward guidance driven by strong module adoption, solid retention rates and a record 2Q pipeline. Both CRWD and PANW sold off earlier in the year as some investors feared cybersecurity LLMs would disrupt incumbent cybersecurity players. In April Anthropic released its Mythos model, and Anthropic granted early access to Mythos to several large cybersecurity companies and other institutions allowing them to use the LLM to detect vulnerabilities before a broader release. CRWD CEO George Kurtz referred to this as an "inflection moment", and rather than a risk for the company, it underscored the importance of a cybersecurity ecosystem. As the use of AI agents proliferates, the risk of breaches and cybersecurity attacks increases, necessitating increased cybersecurity spend. We remain constructive on shares of both PANW and CRWD."

投资管理公司 TCW Funds 发布了“TCW 集中大盘成长基金”2026 年第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可以在此处下载。 第二季度的重大事件包括人工智能货币化、脆弱的中东停火以及美联储领导层换届。 在经济增长强劲和企业盈利强劲的推动下，所有主要股指均收高。 4 月份标志着标准普尔 500 指数从 3 月份的低点开始复苏，到 6 月初，标准普尔 500 指数创下了历史新高，这主要是由于与人工智能资本支出相关的强劲企业盈利。 尽管该基金在本季度升值了 14.45%，但仍落后于 Russell 1000® 增长指数的 16.74% 和标准普尔 500 指数的 15.20% 回报率。 医疗保健和金融领域的持股对相对业绩的影响最大，而信息技术和非必需消费品领域的持股则对本季度的相对业绩产生了积极影响。 请回顾该基金的前五名持股，以深入了解其 2026 年的主要选择。

TCW Concentration Large Cap Growth Fund 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信中重点关注了 CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）。 CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）总部位于德克萨斯州奥斯汀，是一家领先的网络安全技术公司。 2026 年 8 月 12 日，CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）收盘价为每股 221.78 美元，市值为 2258.3 亿美元。 CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）公布的单月回报率为 10.07%，而其股价在过去 52 周内上涨了 111.168%。”

TCW Concentration Large Cap Growth Fund 在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中就 CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）发表了以下声明：

“CrowdStrike Holdings, Inc.（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWD）的股票在公布稳健的季度业绩后也对相对业绩做出了积极贡献，其中包括 2.56 亿美元的 NNARR（新年度经常性净收入）（同比增长 32%）、24% 的非 GAAP 运营利润率（同比增长 6%）和 4.69 亿美元（同比增长 67%）的自由现金流。 管理层还在模块采用强劲、保留率稳定和创纪录的第二季度管道的推动下提出了前瞻性指引。 CRWD 和 PANW 在今年早些时候都被抛售，因为一些投资者担心网络安全法学硕士会扰乱现有的网络安全参与者。 4 月份，Anthropic 发布了其 Mythos 模型，并且 Anthropic 向几家大型网络安全公司和其他机构授予了对 Mythos 的早期访问权限，允许他们在更广泛的发布之前使用 LLM 来检测漏洞。 CRWD 首席执行官乔治·库尔茨 (George Kurtz) 将此称为“拐点”，这不是公司面临的风险，而是强调了网络安全生态系统的重要性。 随着人工智能代理的使用激增，违规和网络安全攻击的风险增加，需要增加网络安全支出。 我们对 PANW 和 CRWD 的股票仍然持建设性态度。”
